boundary: After complete reading and preliminary paper derivation; before new executable controls. Not a preregistration of the discovery of the argument.
mechanism: Simultaneous small-prime Mobius inclusion-exclusion on full four-mode mixed entries, exact rough-composite correction and same-source operator-order test.
predictions: The small-prime divisor sieve gives Lambda_y >= Lambda coefficientwise but not Loewner order after the original P.
Each individual full-k divisor matrix is already affordable; the whole squarefree smooth-divisor sector has price b_m product_(p<=y)(1+p^(-1/2)).
At y=(epsilon log m /8)^2, this auxiliary sector has power 5epsilon/4 up to logarithms; it is not a full-source estimate.
The exact residual has its first nonzero atom at n0=2q, q the first prime larger than y, with weight log 2; translated constrained profiles give both signs.
Keeping the full residual but estimating it by elementary absolute mass returns power 1/2, not an improvement over conditional 3/8.
not_claimed: Counterexample to RH or the original CCM goal
checks_expected: Formal-prime-log arithmetic for the sieve and rough convolution
All sixteen terms of local four-mode matrices and nonidentity metric
Exact contacts of compact polynomial profiles
